about: Mazak QT-Primos 100, self-made in Blender (sources/mazak/build_mazak.py) from Mazak's product photos and the record's specs, replacing the GrabCAD layout model (the library keeps it for the step videos; this one is in its frame): the black base with the lubrication tank behind its window, a pressure gauge, the coolant tank's louvred front panel and handles; the white upper body with the orange-red 'Mazak' logotype; the black sliding door with its round-cornered window, 'QT-PRIMOS 100' lettering and orange grip strip; the tall black MAZATROL panel at the right front with its orange edge, screen, keys and e-stop; a signal tower on the roof. Inside, through the window: the headstock and 6 in chuck holding a bar, the 12-station turret with tools, the chip slope. Behind: the hydraulic unit.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against Mazak's product photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it
